nodes.description: uint16 public constant MAX_NFT_SUPPLY = 1001; upper bound of total NFT supply.
uint256 public constant METAKING_PRICE = 0.5 ether; early bird price for tokenIds 847-848.
uint256 public constant METAVATARS_PRICE = 0.5 ether; early bird price for tokenIds 849-851.
uint256 public constant ARCHAEONS_PRICE = 0.3 ether; early bird price for tokenIds 852-862.
uint256 public constant AEONS_PRICE = 0.3 ether; early bird price for tokenIds 863-901.
uint256 public constant EOS_PRICE = 0.19 ether; early bird price for tokenIds 902-1001.
uint256 public constant SECOND_SALE_PRICE = 0.3 ether; price per NFT in the random second sale.
uint256 public startTime; timestamp after which sales periods are active.
uint16 public pendingCount initialized to MAX_NFT_SUPPLY-155; number of remaining mintable tokens.
bool[1002] public minted; per-token mint flag.
IFacelessNFT public facelessNFT; target NFT contract being sold.
IFacelessNFT public oldFacelessNFT; previous NFT contract used only during migration.
uint16[10000] private _pendingIds; offset array used to derive pending token ids.
SaleStep private _currentSale; current sale phase gate (None/EarlyBirdSale/Airdrop/SecondSale/SoldOut).
address private _dev; recipient of the 15% developer share on withdraw.
address[] private _presaleAddresses; list of presale minters used by migrate().
External caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, ownership check and ETH withdrawal destination.
Miner-influenced block timestamp used for sale period gating and randomness.
(bool sentTreasury, ) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: treasuryShares}(""); low-level ETH transfer to an arbitrary caller.
(bool sentDev, ) = payable(_dev).call{value: devShares}(""); low-level ETH transfer to the dev address.
facelessNFT.mint(to, tokenId) external call inside airdropTransfer.
facelessNFT.mint(msg.sender, tokenId) external call inside standardPurchase.
facelessNFT.mint(_to, tokenId) external call inside _randomMint invoked by randomPurchase.
facelessNFT.mint(minter, i) external call inside the migrate loop.
oldFacelessNFT.ownerOf(i) external view call inside the migrate loop.
pendingCount-- arithmetic decrement in _popPendingAtIndex.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, pendingCount)) used as a randomness source.
constructor(address oldNftAddress, address nftAddress, address dev, address[] memory presaleAddresses) sets NFT contracts, dev and presale list.
setCurrentSale(SaleStep _sale) external onlyOwner; moves the sale state machine.
setStartTime(uint256 _startTime) external onlyOwner; sets the sale start timestamp.
airdropTransfer(address to, uint16 tokenId) external airdropPeriod onlyOwner; owner-gated free mint.
standardPurchase(uint16 tokenId) external payable earlyBirdSalePeriod periodStarted; fixed-price early bird mint.
randomPurchase(uint256 numberOfNfts) external payable secondSalePeriod periodStarted; buys up to 20 pseudo-random NFTs.
withdraw() external onlyOwner; splits balance 15/85 between _dev and msg.sender using low-level calls.
getPendingAtIndex(uint16 _index) public view returns (uint16); reads _pendingIds offset.
_getPendingIndexById(uint16 tokenId, uint16 startIndex, uint16 totalCount) internal view; linear scan for a pending token id.
_getMintPrice(uint16 tokenId) internal pure; maps tokenId ranges to early bird prices.
_popPendingAtIndex(uint16 _index) internal; swaps the last pending id into the popped slot and decrements pendingCount.
_randomMint(address _to) internal; picks a pseudo-random index, pops it and mints.
migrate() external onlyOwner; re-mints old-collection holdings of presale addresses into the new contract.
_getRandom() internal view returns (uint256); block.difficulty/timestamp/pendingCount based pseudo-randomness.
owner() public view virtual returns (address); returns the Ownable owner used by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) public virtual onlyOwner; transfers contract ownership.
renounceOwnership() public virtual onlyOwner; renounces ownership of the contract.
SaleStep _sale parameter of setCurrentSale.
uint256 _startTime parameter of setStartTime.
address to parameter of airdropTransfer (mint recipient).
uint16 tokenId parameter of airdropTransfer.
uint16 tokenId parameter of standardPurchase.
uint256 numberOfNfts parameter of randomPurchase.
address oldNftAddress parameter of constructor.
address nftAddress parameter of constructor.
address dev parameter of constructor.
address[] presaleAddresses parameter of constructor.
uint16 tokenId parameter of _getPendingIndexById.
uint16 startIndex parameter of _getPendingIndexById.
uint16 totalCount parameter of _getPendingIndexById.
uint16 tokenId parameter of _getMintPrice.
uint16 _index parameter of _popPendingAtIndex.
address _to parameter of _randomMint.
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
uint16 nftIndex computed from _getPendingIndexById in airdropTransfer.
uint16 nftIndex computed from _getPendingIndexById in standardPurchase.
uint i loop counter of the mint loop in randomPurchase.
uint256 devShares = balance*15/100 in withdraw.
uint256 treasuryShares = balance - devShares in withdraw.
bool sentTreasury returned by the low-level call to msg.sender.
bool sentDev returned by the low-level call to _dev.
uint16 i loop counter of the scan loop in _getPendingIndexById.
uint16 pendingTokenId from getPendingAtIndex inside _getPendingIndexById.
uint16 tokenId returned by getPendingAtIndex in _popPendingAtIndex.
uint16 lastPendingId read from getPendingAtIndex(pendingCount) in _popPendingAtIndex.
uint16 index derived from _getRandom() % pendingCount in _randomMint.
uint256 tokenId returned by _popPendingAtIndex in _randomMint.
uint16 idx loop counter over _presaleAddresses in migrate.
address minter = _presaleAddresses[idx] in migrate.
uint16 i loop counter over token ids 847..1001 in migrate.

edges.reason: MAX_NFT_SUPPLY defines the initial value of pendingCount.
MAX_NFT_SUPPLY caps facelessNFT.totalSupply()+numberOfNfts in randomPurchase.
SECOND_SALE_PRICE is used to validate msg.value in randomPurchase.
METAKING_PRICE is returned by _getMintPrice for metaking token ids.
METAVATARS_PRICE is returned by _getMintPrice for metavatar token ids.
ARCHAEONS_PRICE is returned by _getMintPrice for archaeon token ids.
AEONS_PRICE is returned by _getMintPrice for aeon token ids.
EOS_PRICE is returned by _getMintPrice for eos token ids.
startTime is read by the periodStarted modifier of standardPurchase.
startTime is read by the periodStarted modifier of randomPurchase.
setStartTime writes the startTime state variable.
pendingCount > 0 is required at the start of randomPurchase.
pendingCount is decremented in _popPendingAtIndex, which can underflow if it reaches zero.
pendingCount is part of the pseudo-random seed in _getRandom.
_randomMint computes index from _getRandom() % pendingCount.
minted[tokenId] is set to true in airdropTransfer.
minted[tokenId] is set to true in standardPurchase.
minted[tokenId] is set to true in _randomMint.
minted[i] is set to true in migrate.
facelessNFT.mint is invoked in airdropTransfer.
facelessNFT.mint is invoked in standardPurchase.
facelessNFT.mint is invoked in _randomMint.
facelessNFT.mint is invoked in migrate.
oldFacelessNFT.ownerOf is queried in migrate.
_pendingIds is read to compute the pending token id in getPendingAtIndex.
_pendingIds is written when the last pending id is swapped in _popPendingAtIndex.
setCurrentSale writes _currentSale.
The airdropPeriod modifier reads _currentSale.
The earlyBirdSalePeriod modifier reads _currentSale.
The secondSalePeriod modifier reads _currentSale.
_dev receives devShares through the low-level call in withdraw.
_presaleAddresses are iterated in migrate.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in standardPurchase.
msg.sender receives treasuryShares via a low-level call before the require check in withdraw.
withdraw sends ETH directly to the caller-supplied msg.sender.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner() before transferOwnership.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts airdropTransfer using msg.sender.
periodStarted compares block.timestamp with startTime in standardPurchase.
periodStarted compares block.timestamp with startTime in randomPurchase.
setStartTime requires _startTime > block.timestamp.
block.timestamp is mixed into the pseudo-random seed in _getRandom.
airdropTransfer calls _getPendingIndexById to locate the token.
airdropTransfer calls _popPendingAtIndex to remove the pending entry.
airdropTransfer performs the mint after the minted flag is set.
standardPurchase calls _getPendingIndexById to locate the token.
standardPurchase calls _popPendingAtIndex to remove the pending entry.
standardPurchase calls _getMintPrice to validate msg.value.
standardPurchase performs the mint to msg.sender.
The randomPurchase loop calls _randomMint numberOfNfts times.
_randomMint calls _getRandom to pick an index.
_randomMint calls _popPendingAtIndex to remove the chosen id.
_randomMint performs the mint for the caller.
migrate queries oldFacelessNFT.ownerOf inside the nested loops.
migrate mints the matching ids on the new contract.
_getPendingIndexById calls getPendingAtIndex in its scan loop.
_popPendingAtIndex calls getPendingAtIndex for the popped and last indexes.
withdraw executes the low-level call paying msg.sender.
withdraw executes the low-level call paying _dev.
The low-level call to msg.sender forwards all gas and can re-enter withdraw before state is finalized.
The low-level call to _dev forwards gas and can re-enter withdraw.
External facelessNFT.mint callback during airdropTransfer.
External facelessNFT.mint callback during standardPurchase.
External facelessNFT.mint callback during the randomPurchase loop.
External facelessNFT.mint callback during migrate.
External oldFacelessNFT.ownerOf callback during migrate.

normalization_plan.reason: The _sale argument only exists to be assigned into _currentSale by setCurrentSale.
The _startTime argument is validated and stored into startTime by setStartTime.
The to argument is only used as the mint recipient inside airdropTransfer.
The tokenId argument is only used for pending-index lookup inside airdropTransfer.
The tokenId argument is only used for pending-index and price lookup inside standardPurchase.
The numberOfNfts argument only drives the mint loop and payment check in randomPurchase.
The oldNftAddress argument is only cast and stored as oldFacelessNFT in the constructor.
The nftAddress argument is only cast and stored as facelessNFT in the constructor.
The dev argument is only stored into _dev by the constructor.
The presaleAddresses argument is only stored into _presaleAddresses by the constructor.
The tokenId argument is only compared against pending ids inside _getPendingIndexById.
The startIndex argument only bounds the scan loop of _getPendingIndexById.
The totalCount argument only bounds the scan loop of _getPendingIndexById.
The tokenId argument only selects the returned price branch in _getMintPrice.
The _index argument only selects the slot to pop in _popPendingAtIndex.
The _to argument is only forwarded as the mint recipient in _randomMint.
The newOwner argument is only validated and passed to _setOwner by transferOwnership.
nftIndex is the direct return value of _getPendingIndexById in airdropTransfer.
nftIndex is the direct return value of _getPendingIndexById in standardPurchase.
The i counter only drives the bounded mint loop of randomPurchase.
devShares is the exact value transferred by the low-level call to _dev.
treasuryShares is the exact value transferred by the low-level call to msg.sender.
sentTreasury is the success flag returned by the low-level call to msg.sender.
sentDev is the success flag returned by the low-level call to _dev.
The i counter only drives the scan loop of _getPendingIndexById.
pendingTokenId is the direct return value of getPendingAtIndex inside _getPendingIndexById.
tokenId is the direct return value of getPendingAtIndex inside _popPendingAtIndex.
lastPendingId only holds the swapped value written back into _pendingIds in _popPendingAtIndex.
index is derived directly from the _getRandom() output modulo pendingCount.
tokenId is the direct return value of _popPendingAtIndex inside _randomMint.
The idx counter only iterates _presaleAddresses inside migrate.
minter is only an alias of _presaleAddresses[idx] used in the migrate comparison.
The i counter only supplies the token id queried from oldFacelessNFT.ownerOf in migrate.
